product.olivetti-m10.summary: Development entry for bringing up the Olivetti M10 on the CoreMach engine. Not a catalogue sheet.
product.olivetti-m10.warning: DEVELOPMENT ONLY: shown only with BLUMACH_CATALOG_DEVELOPMENT=1. Needs the local 32 KB system ROM in roms/machines/olivetti_m10/.
product.olivetti-m10.creation.clock.host: Host time, keeps running while off
product.olivetti-m10.creation.note: The RAM and clock are kept in the machine folder (state/ram.bin, state/rtc.bin).
